question_text:
Let  \[f(x) =
\begin{cases}
k(x) &\text{if }x>0, \\
-\frac1{2x}&\text{if }x< 0\\
0&\text{if }x=0.
\end{cases}
\]Find the function $k(x)$ such that $f(x)$ is its own inverse function.

Return only the final boxed answer content as a concise mathematical expression.
